name: etmoney-mcp-server
description: Read-only research layer over ET Money - all 67 mutual fund categories, stock screens, NIFTY index and sector constituents
long_description:
# etmoney-lyr

Reverse-engineers ET Money's research surfaces into agent tools: mutual funds across equity/debt/hybrid/gold/index/FoF categories, stock market screens, index and sector constituents. No login required; no transactions.

## Quick start

1. Install: install.sh or `uv tool install git+https://github.com/ishan-parihar/etmoney-lyr.git`
2. Run server: `etmoney-lyr`
3. Research: mf_search -> mf_detail -> mf_compare
